_: The edit, in frames of the 30 fps film. Every cut point was read off the supplied files themselves (docs/source-cuts.md).

cartoon._crop: the 4:3 picture inside the file's blurred pillarbox, x 280-1640 (inside the black edge lines at 273-275 and 1644-1646), y 30-1050: exactly 4:3, square pixels, no stretch

card._: the card the set plays where the Nickelodeon ident used to be (comp/card.py), in the ident's slot: film frames 226-321, the same 96 frames; its frame 95 is where the glitch interrupts it (the glitch freezes on 95 and stutters back to 94, as it did on the ident)
card._secondLineAt: card frame the second line lands on (0.6 s in, film frame 244); the first line lands on the card's first frame

countdown._: the countdown's signal breaks through during the glitch's last frames (showing its starting value); its clock starts when the signal locks, at clockOriginFrame, and it runs to the film's last frame
